modules.title: Git Basics
modules.description: Commit, branch, merge, resolve a conflict, and rebase across five small scenario repos.

checkpoints.title: First commit
checkpoints.description: Add your name to roster.txt and commit it with a real message.

checkpoints.title: Feature branch
checkpoints.description: Branch off develop as issue-12-<description> and make at least two commits.

checkpoints.title: Merge
checkpoints.description: Merge the finished issue-7-auto-distance branch into develop.

checkpoints.title: Merge conflict
checkpoints.description: Merge issue-9-max-speed into develop and resolve the conflict.

checkpoints.title: Rebase
checkpoints.description: Rebase issue-15-led-colors onto the latest develop.

modules.title: AdvantageScope: Reading Robot Telemetry
modules.description: Generate a telemetry log, then configure AdvantageScope's layout to display it.

checkpoints.title: Flywheel RPM
checkpoints.description: flywheelRpm(t) oscillates between 0 and 6000.

checkpoints.title: Game piece loaded
checkpoints.description: gamePieceLoaded(t) toggles as t changes.

checkpoints.title: Flywheel line graph
checkpoints.description: A Line Graph tab plots FlywheelRPM.

checkpoints.title: Locked axis scale
checkpoints.description: The Line Graph's Y axis is locked to roughly 0-6000.

checkpoints.title: Game piece table
checkpoints.description: A Table tab lists GamePieceLoaded.

checkpoints.title: Prints Hello, World!
checkpoints.description: Running Main prints "Hello, World!" to standard out.

modules.title: Variables
modules.description: Declare variables, define a constant, and define your first enum.

checkpoints.title: Team number
checkpoints.description: teamNumber() returns 4143 from a local variable.

checkpoints.title: Max speed constant
checkpoints.description: A public static final MAX_SPEED constant equal to 5.0 (team standard: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE).

checkpoints.title: Alliance enum
checkpoints.description: An ALLIANCE enum with RED and BLUE values (team standard: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE).

modules.title: Operators
modules.description: Do arithmetic, conversions, and comparisons with Java's operators.

checkpoints.title: Add two ints
checkpoints.description: addInts(a, b) returns a + b.

checkpoints.title: Inches to meters
checkpoints.description: inchesToMeters(inches) converts using 1 inch = 0.0254 meters.

checkpoints.title: Is even
checkpoints.description: isEven(value) uses the modulo operator to detect even numbers.

modules.title: Conditions
modules.description: Write if/else chains and switch statements.

checkpoints.title: Battery status
checkpoints.description: batteryStatus(percent) maps a percentage to EMPTY/LOW/MEDIUM/FULL.

checkpoints.title: Day name
checkpoints.description: dayName(day) uses a switch statement to name the day of the week.

modules.title: Loops
modules.description: Write for loops instead of the dangerous while loop.

checkpoints.title: Sum with a loop
checkpoints.description: sumTo(n) adds up 1..n using a for loop.

checkpoints.title: Count divisible by three
checkpoints.description: countDivisibleByThree(n) counts multiples of 3 from 1..n.

modules.title: Arrays
modules.description: Write methods that take and return arrays.

checkpoints.title: Array max
checkpoints.description: max(values) returns the largest element.

checkpoints.title: Array average
checkpoints.description: average(values) returns the mean as a double.

checkpoints.title: Double every element
checkpoints.description: doubleAll(values) returns a new array without mutating the input.

checkpoints.title: Array contains
checkpoints.description: contains(values, target) searches the array for a value.

modules.title: Methods
modules.description: Write void methods, methods with parameters, and methods that return a value.

checkpoints.title: Stop motor (void)
checkpoints.description: stopMotor() is a void method that prints MOTOR STOPPED.

checkpoints.title: Sum three
checkpoints.description: sumThree(a, b, c) takes three parameters and returns their sum.

checkpoints.title: Team name
checkpoints.description: teamName() takes no parameters and returns a fixed String.

modules.title: Classes & Objects
modules.description: Build the docs' MotorController example: fields, a constructor, and encapsulation.

checkpoints.title: Constructor & direction
checkpoints.description: The constructor sets motor_direction_ from is_reversed.

checkpoints.title: Enable required
checkpoints.description: setMotorSpeed does nothing until enableMotor() is called.

checkpoints.title: Disable
checkpoints.description: disableMotor() zeroes the speed and re-gates setMotorSpeed.

checkpoints.title: Independent objects
checkpoints.description: Two MotorController objects keep their own, separate state.

modules.title: Robot Starter
modules.description: A minimal WPILib and AdvantageKit command-based robot you run from the Driver Station.
